sections.description:
Short Title and Commencement

THE GORAKH HILLS DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
THE GORAKH HILLS DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2013
SINDH ACT NO. LV
OF 2013
KARACHI,
THE 21ST NOVEMBER, 2013
AN
ACT
NO.PAS/Legis-B-22/2013-The
Gorakh Hills Development Authority (Amendment) Bill,
2013 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 4th November, 2013 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 19th November, 2014 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh to amend the Gorakh Hills Development Authority Act, 2008.
Preamble.-
WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Gorakh
Hills Development Authority Act, 2008, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short Title and Commencement: -
(1) This Act may be called the Gorakh Hills Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
